scenarios.name: Keep a heading folded when switching tabs
scenarios.reason:
You asked to collapse the “First section,” switch to the other.md tab and back to fold.md, then read the section control’s tooltip.
The “First section” was collapsed, the requested tabs were selected in order, and the section control was hovered.
The tooltip read “Unfold this section,” and the only visible editor paragraph was “Visible body.”

steps.remark: click: Clicking the chevron to the left of Fold this section
analyze: ANALYZE(visual, 'The only paragraph you can read on screen in the editor says "V
assert: The tooltip says "Unfold this section".
assert: The only paragraph you can read on screen in the editor says "Visible body".

fix.summary: Switching tabs rebuilt the editor from Markdown and discarded heading folds. The editor now saves and restores each tab’s folded sections and their boundaries.
